identity_fragmentation.interpretation: Track support is operational. GT person support is evaluator-only. False passes mean the same numeric track-support threshold would fail on modeled people, not a measured attack or k-anonymity proof.
identity_fragmentation.intervention: Only identity labels change. Fragment boundaries are global simulation-time multiples of the declared interval; positions, types, batches and cadence are fixed.

native.peak_metric_scope: Diagnostic maximum simultaneous sampled modeled-person support only; not an implemented policy variant or proof of privacy.
native.utility_scope: Observation retention and weighted representation/delay summaries; no task-query error or measured privacy risk.

identity_fragmentation.oracle_scope: Stable GT identity variant is an explicitly privileged evaluation reference; never a sensor/aggregator capability or proposed production fix.

progress_clock.scope: Replay uses every native numerical source tick, including no-measurement ticks; identity interventions preserve the same clock.

interpretation: Track support is not a k-anonymity or person-reidentification guarantee.
Fragmented-ID false passes apply an alternative modeled-person numeric threshold only; all recorded operational track checks can still pass.
One source/seed per flow case; no confidence interval or population-level superiority claim.
Whole-cell query coverage, suppression and error must be read jointly; missing output is unknown, not zero.
Corridor source uses conservative gate reservations with queues; body safety/drainage is not calibrated urban traffic realism.
Native wall time includes startup and database I/O; it does not prove per-step realtime deadlines.
